title: Catch Me Who Can
author: Polly Thomas
description:
Award-winning audio director and producer Polly Thomas and writer Charlotte Delaney have brought together a team of incredible actors to deliver never-before produced or performed Shelagh Delaney play Catch Me Who Can as an audio drama for Thomas Carter Projects. Celebrated actor Rita Tushingham, who made her screen debut in the iconic 1961 film version of A Taste of Honey, is united with Delaney’s work once again alongside award-winning stage and screen actor Toby Jones as Mr. Halliwell, and two extraordinary emerging talents Ivy Sheehan as Hattie and Xavier Moras Spencer as Boy, with original music by Max Delaney. T

 

Catch Me Who Can is a play that asks questions about freedom. It tells the story of Hattie, a teenage girl trying to find her freedom by running away from school and home. Her search, or her desire for escape has a profound influence on her teacher Mr. Halliwell, played by Toby Jones, whose rather cosy life is unsettled by her ‘flight’.

 

Charlotte said:

‘My mum wrote Catch Me Who Can in response to me running away from home for 2 days and nights when I was 14, in 1978 and it imagines my last day ‘on the lam’. My mum never really liked school, and she always understood why I hated it – to have to go to the same place every day for years and years whether you like it or not!!! She liked young people, she listened to them, she got their voices right because she respected them and they made her laugh. Like all my mum’s work, the play’s depth and profundity are achieved through economy and humour, pockets of heartbreak and dialogue that falls easily out of the actors’ mouths.'

  • কোরআন ও সুন্নাহর আলোয় জীবন: পবিত্র কোরআন এবং প্রিয় নবী হযরত মুহাম্মদ (সা.)-এর সুমহান হাদিসের আলোকে জীবনের নানা সমস্যার সুরাহা ও আত্মশুদ্ধির আলোচনা।
  • সাহাবি ও বুজুর্গদের জীবনী: সাহাবায়ে কেরাম ও ইসলামের ইতিহাসের মহান ব্যক্তিত্বদের ত্যাগের ইতিহাস, যা আমাদের ঈমানকে শাণিত করবে।
  • নৈতিকতা ও মূল্যবোধ: বর্তমান প্রজন্মের জন্য ইসলামের সঠিক ও সুন্দর শিক্ষা, যা মন ও চরিত্রকে পবিত্র করে তোলে।
অজ্ঞতার সমস্ত অন্ধকার ভেদ করে আপনার হৃদয়ে ঈমানের নূর জ্বেলে দিতে এবং জীবনের পথে সঠিক দিশা পেতে আমাদের সাথে যুক্ত থাকুন।🎧 নিয়মিত নতুন পর্ব শুনতে আমাদের পেজটি ফলো/সাবস্ক্রাইব করে সাথেই থাকুন।এই বিবরণটি আপনার পডকাস্টের পরিচয় ফুটিয়ে তুলতে দারুণভাবে সাহায্য করবে। এতে কি আর কোনো পরিবর্তন বা সংযোজন করতে চান?

Take care of yourself. And take care of your gals. 💕

title: Rest Yourself Radio Podcast
author: Rest Yourself Radio
description:
Rest Yourself Radio exists to help you rest in God, grow as a disciple of Jesus Christ, and be spiritually strengthened through the truth of Scripture and the power of the Holy Spirit.

Each episode is designed to point you back to the Father through biblical teaching, honest conversation, testimony, prayer, and practical discipleship. Together, we explore the Word of God, the life and teachings of Jesus, biblical feasts and their significance, spiritual growth, identity in Christ, and what it looks like to live out our faith in everyday life.

Our heart is not simply to gain more biblical knowledge, but to become people whose lives visibly reflect Jesus.

Come rest, learn, grow, and be encouraged as we pursue a deeper relationship with the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.

Rest Yourself Family Ministries
To Rest, Disciple, Assist and Spiritually Inspire at-need families.

title: Super Snakes That Meditate
author: Eleah and London
description: Super Snakes That Meditate is a calm-down podcast for kids with big energy, made by a mom and her kid. Each episode, London picks a snake, venomous or squeezing, and Eleah turns it into a short meditation about one feeling. The snake facts are real. The interruptions stay in. Episodes run about six minutes, good for before school, after a meltdown, or at bedtime.

title: West Mesa Files Unsealed
author: AC Wilson
description:
In 2009, a discovery in the desert outside Albuquerque exposed one of New Mexico’s most haunting unsolved murder investigations. The remains of eleven women and an unborn child were recovered from Albuquerque’s West Mesa, revealing a mystery that remains unresolved. West Mesa Files Unsealed takes a deep look into the disappearances, the victims whose lives were tragically cut short, the massive investigation that followed, forensic evidence, persons of interest, and the questions investigators are still trying to answer.

Disclaimer

West Mesa Files Unsealed is an independent true-crime podcast created for informational, educational, and documentary purposes. This podcast is not affiliated with, sponsored by, endorsed by, or officially connected to the Albuquerque Police Department, the City of Albuquerque, any law-enforcement agency, the victims' families, or any individual or organization discussed in the program.
Information presented in this podcast is drawn from publicly available sources, which may include official statements, government and court records, established news reporting, interviews, and other published materials. Information may change as investigations continue or new evidence becomes publicly available. Individuals discussed as suspects, persons of interest, or possible connections to the investigation should not be considered responsible for any crime unless and until their guilt has been established in a court of law. Theories, allegations, disputed claims, and speculation will be identified as such whenever appropriate. This podcast discusses murder, missing persons, violence, sexual exploitation, and other potentially disturbing subjects. Listener discretion is advised. Above all, West Mesa Files Unsealed seeks to approach the case with respect for the victims and their families. The victims were people with lives, families, relationships, and stories beyond the circumstances of their deaths.

title: THAT ONE CALL
author: Officer Andrew
description: THAT ONE CALL is a show for first responders, by first responders. We give the unpolished truth about what it's like to be a police officer, firefighter, 911 dispatcher etc. We address the cost this work can take on your soul and mental health. We are advocates for improving the spiritual, physical and emotional health of all of those who answer the call.

author: Amazing Night
description:
🔎 Where we explore the Game of Power. We analyse different organisations, history and characters, to extract important lessons that You can positively use in the real world, whether helping you in the world of business, entrepreneurship or even just personal development, we got you covered.

🍿 We also go into deep analysis and uncovering unbelievable hidden facts about your favourite films, novels and tv shows, Sharing the secrets of some of the most iconic films ever made and looking into historical events that inspired these films.

🎯 Our main goal is to provide you with informative yet entertaining mini-documentaries

title: KAJ Recovery & Renewal LIVE
author: Khudania Ajay
description:
Honest conversations on addiction, sobriety, and the long road to recovery — and the personal renewal that comes with it.

Hosted by Khudania Ajay (KAJ), independent journalist with 2,500+ long-form conversations.

Real stories, real struggle, real hope — never for show.

Recovery isn't one moment. It's everything that comes after.

Become a supporter of this podcast: https://www.spreaker.com/podcast/kaj-recovery-renewal-live--7189412/support.

title: After the Amen
author: Calvary Episcopal Church
description: A short DAILY VLOG & Podcast from Calvary Episcopal Church in Ashland, KY, following the Forward Day by Day devotional and daily Scripture.Each day, Alyse & Cade sit down to talk about the day’s verse, what it might be saying to us, how it connects with everyday life—and usually a little bit about life itself.No sermons. No complicated theology. Just Scripture, real life, conversation, and our take.

title: Healthy Living Simple with Dr Lisa O
author: Dr Lisa Olszewski
description:
Hey there, Rockstar — I'm so glad you're here.
I'm Dr. Lisa O, a chiropractor, naturopath/ functional medicine practitioner who's spent the last 20+ years helping women and men in midlife figure out what's actually happening in their bodies — and what to do about it.
If you've been told your labs are "fine" but you know something is off — the brain fog, the exhaustion, the weight that won't move, the libido that disappeared, the rage you don't recognize — this show is for you. We go deep on hormones, the DUTCH test, bioidentical therapy, and the real root causes that conventional medicine often misses.
No dismissal. No wellness hype. Just honest medicine from a doctor who's been in practice long enough to know the difference.
Welcome back. The best chapter is still ahead.
With love and real results,
Dr. Lisa O

title: Always & Forever
author: Elliana
description:
Always and Forever 🤍

A Christ-centered podcast where each episode we rope in how we can grow deeper in our faith, walk boldly with Jesus, and find Him in every season of life.

Here we’ll talk about faith, friendships, purpose, identity, struggles, growth, and the many journey's we face following Christ. My hope is that every episode reminds you that God is always with you, His promises are forever, and your story is safest in His hands.

Always and Forever — because God's love truly is. ✝️🤍

Hosted by marketing strategists, we cut through the noise of outdated tactics to bring you actionable insights on social media growth, paid advertising, SEO, content marketing, and consumer psychology. Whether you're an e-commerce entrepreneur, a digital marketer, or a small business owner looking to scale, we've got the exact strategies you need. Hit subscribe and let's grow your business!

title: Infamous Murder
author: Extra Super! BIG®
description:
Infamous Murder tells the chilling stories of killers whose crimes became impossible to forget. Each episode dives into the murders, the victims, the investigations, the motives, the courtroom battles, and the disturbing details that turned ordinary names into symbols of fear.

From notorious serial killers and mass murderers to shocking crimes that captured global attention, Infamous Murder separates fact from legend and reconstructs the cases with gripping, deeply researched storytelling.

These aren’t just stories about how people died. They’re stories about how killers were created, how they were caught, what they left behind, and why the world still remembers their names.

A true crime podcast from Extra Super! BIG®.

title: Musicians Reveal: Beyond
author: Joe Kelley
description: Musicians Reveal: Beyond opens the archives for conversations with musicians, artists, authors and creative voices across jazz, blues, rock, gospel, R&B and beyond. description:
Between the Leaves, a poetry podcast hosted by Ellen van Neerven and Hermina Burns. In each episode, Ellen and Hermina illuminate poems written by women and the gender diverse, as well as their own original works, moving through themes like love, race and feminism.
Proudly presented by the Victorian Women’s Trust.

description:
PITCH IT is a podcast where hosts Chris "The Positive C" Edwards and James "Thorny" Thornquist are given a random concept and have 60 minutes to turn that idea into a well rounded elevator pitch. Can they do it, or will their ideas plummet and crash into a mess of chaos? Listen to find out and feel free to write along and share your ideas on any of their social media platforms. Don't forget, you can submit your ideas to the wheel also by reaching out!

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

Hosted by relationship enthusiasts, we break down the psychology of attachment styles, how to build healthy boundaries, resolving conflicts without toxicity, and keeping the spark alive in long-term partnerships. Whether you're single and dating, newly engaged, or navigating decades of marriage, we've got the real talk you need. Hit subscribe and let's decode love together!

Ready to journey with God at a new level?

Feeling like there’s gotta be more to your Christian Walk than just "this"?

Want to learn how to start, build, and grow your online ministry?

SisterFriend, this is the safe haven you’ve been searching for to be encouraged and empowered to live boldly in God’s unique design for you.

You're going to find the support you need, as you intentionally walk in your Kingdom purpose.

You'll also get my best tips, strategies, and resources so you can grow your ministry platform, as a Kingdom Influencer who glorifies the Lord, spreads the Gospel, and points people to Christ.

And remember this, there’s only one way to live a spirit-filled life and build a Spirit-filled ministry and that’s to dance with the King Christ Jesus!

title: Restoring the Fallen Leaders
author: Raenel
description:
Hi, I’m Raenel.
I was a full-time evangelist who fell in one moment of lust that spiraled into 27 years. I stayed because there was nowhere to go. I was already going to hell, and I knew that God wouldn’t forgive me. But, He left the ninety-nine and came after me.

www.raenel.com

description: Love Without Limits explores age-gap relationships, LGBTQ+ love, long-distance relationships, later-life love, and the courage to build a life that doesn't fit someone else's expectations. Hosted by Kevin Richards, the podcast begins with Kevin and Marco's extraordinary story and grows into conversations about love, judgment, aging, acceptance, and the people who prove that meaningful relationships don't come with an expiration date.

title: Sleepy Stories: Classic stories
author: 1 misborn
description:
Have you ever wanted to step through a doorway in time and immerse yourself in stories that changed the world?
Welcome to The Best Classic Audiobooks — a sanctuary for timeless literary masterpieces brought to life through the power of the spoken word.

Here, the storied pages of Jane Austen, Charles Dickens, Arthur Conan Doyle, and many other renowned authors come alive through evocative narration, transforming your walks, cooking sessions, or bedtime routines into magical adventures. Hit "Subscribe" today so you don't miss out on these extraordinary chapters!

title: Leap Academy with Ilana Golan
author: Ilana Golan
description:
The Leap Academy Podcast with Ilana Golan is all about honest and inspiring conversations about what it really takes to leap to bigger things, amazing careers, and craft the life you want.


Stories and tips you won't find anywhere else.


Ilana speaks with some of the world's most influential people, experts, and thinkers who created incredible careers, massive impact, built a reputation, and an extraordinary life.


Together we discover the untold truths, the emotions, and important lessons that enabled them to reinvent themselves & leap. 


We take our audience on a journey that will not only inspire but also teach concrete lessons on how to leap careers: fast-track to leadership, jump to entrepreneurship, build a personal brand, portfolio career, and much more.

Each episode offers encouraging messages, thoughtful reflections, and positive inspiration to help you overcome self-doubt, grow from within, and believe in the person you’re becoming. Tune in for reminders that your voice matters, your journey is valuable, and confidence begins with you.

title: Red Tree Pod
author: Red Tree
description:
The Red Tree Pod is a bi-weekly podcast hosted by Davis Johnson, Chris Wachter, and Laura Rinas. It's brought to you by Red Tree, a multi-church ministry seeking to connect the clarity of God's grace to our otherwise confusing lives and attempts at reading the Bible.
You can learn more about Red Tree at redtreegrace.com.

title: Developing Imperfect Leaders
author: Leadership Development Institute
description: The Developing Imperfect Leaders podcast is intended to develop imperfect people into better leaders. None of us are perfect, fully-realized people, which is why leadership development exists in the first place! Since we are NOT Jesus, we all have room for growth in our lives and we need help along the way. Therefore, each episode is designed to help anyone to become a better leader by examining a provocative question on a relevant leadership topic, looking at quotes from beneficial resources, and thinking through the practical application for growing in our  imperfect leadership. If you are a perfect person who has life, relationships, and leadership all figured out, then this podcast is NOT for you. But, if you are someone who loves learning, growing, and improving. then this is something you'll enjoy and benefit from.

title: Romans Untangled
author: Steve Treichler
description:
Romans Untangled is a weekly podcast that takes a seemingly complicated book of the Bible and untangles it so we can see its beauty. 
Pastor Steve Treichler of Hope Community Church in Minneapolis, MN is our host as we make this wonderful book of the apostle Paul accessible to all - those who are new to the Bible, as well as those who have been a follower of Christ for years and years.

title: Aristin On Air
author: Aristin On Air
description: Welcome to Aristin On Air the show where I, Aristin, share anything and everything that’s on my mind whether it’s advice, social commentary, hot takes or just crazy story times. One thing I really value is sharing perspective and this seems to be the perfect place to do just that. So join me on this journey of sharing perspective and hopefully I can make you laugh or feel seen along the way. Tune in (hopefully) every week for new episodes. Videos version available on my Youtube channel @ArisitnOnAir.

title: Petticoat Revolution
author: Daphne Woolsoncroft, Charlotte Long
description: Petticoat Revolution is a weekly history video podcast hosted by twin sisters Charlotte Long and Daphne Woolsoncroft. Each episode explores iconic historical figures and events that shaped our past, present, and future. It’s where history meets girl talk - full of scandal, intrigue, and the stories you wish you’d learned in school. Come for the yearning, stay for the learning.

title: The AI for Health Plans Podcast
author: Frankie Barrett on Behalf of Healthplans.AI
description:
AI for Health Plans
The honest conversation about AI in the health plan industry.

Hosted by Donna Reed and Joseph Ancil of healthplans.ai, AI for Health Plans cuts through the noise to get real about what artificial intelligence actually means for health plan leaders. No vendor hype, no sci-fi panic, no vague promises of transformation. Just clear thinking from the people living this shift every day.

Each episode, Donna and Joseph dig into the questions health plan executives are actually asking behind closed doors: What's working? What's overhyped? Where does AI deliver real ROI, and where are leaders wasting budget chasing the wrong use cases? They cover strategy, operations, member experience, compliance, and the human side of this transformation, alongside guest conversations with thought leaders, health plan executives, and innovators building the future of the industry.

Hosted by brand and growth leader Majid Boroujerdi and patent attorney and entrepreneur Jeff Schell, the show explores startups, venture capital, technology, consumer brands, real estate, outdoor, food, hospitality, and the civic forces driving the Front Range economy. Watch full episodes and clips on YouTube.

title: The Middle Seat Podcast

Two people who are sick of the noise, digging into why Washington doesn't work — one topic at a time. Every claim is fact-checked against primary sources before it airs. Uncomfortable conversations from an uncomfortable seat.

title: The Ensemble School: From Solo Teachers to Educator Teams
author: Roger Osorio
description:
*Moving from isolated solo performers to orchestrated educator teams that produce transformative learning experiences.*
For over a century, the industrial school model has forced educators to be solo performers—closing the classroom door each morning to carry the entire academic, behavioral, and emotional load of 30 students alone. The result isn't a failure of teacher resilience; it is a structural failure of design that fuels unprecedented burnout and unsustainable turnover.
The Ensemble School is the blueprint for what comes next.
Hosted by educator, author, and University of Pennsylvania GSE faculty member Roger Osorio, this show explores the national movement to dismantle the "one-teacher, one-classroom" paradigm and replace it with distributed, team-based educator models.
Drawing inspiration from how high-caliber theatrical productions and agile teams coordinate specialized talent, we go behind the scenes with the pioneering superintendents, principals, implementation coaches, and researchers (including Arizona State University’s Next Education Workforce ) who are restructuring schools from the ground up.
Each episode delivers candid, tactical insights into:
* *The Structural Shift:* How to re-engineer master schedules, budgets, and physical spaces to support shared-roster teaching pods.
* *The Cultural Reality:* Managing change-anxiety, building psychological safety, and establishing trust among educator teams.
* *The Policy & Funding Levers:* How school boards, elected officials, and philanthropic foundations can catalyze workforce transformation.
* *The Real-World Outcomes:* What happens to student engagement, equity, and teacher retention when educators finally have an ensemble behind them.
Whether you are a district leader ready to pilot your first team, a policymaker funding workforce innovation, or an educator tired of standing alone, The Ensemble School gives you the field-tested strategies to build a more sustainable, human-centered future for education.

title: Carmen by Prosper Mérimée.
author: Popular Culture and Religion.
description:
Carmen by Prosper Mérimée.  
Carmen is a novella by the French author Prosper Mérimée, first published in 1845 in the periodical Revue des deux Mondes and presented initially without indication that it was fiction, appearing instead as a travelogue account. The story is framed by an unnamed French scholar and archaeologist traveling in Andalusia in 1830, who encounters the outlaw Don José Navarro in the mountains, aids his escape, and later meets the charismatic Gypsy woman Carmen in Córdoba before hearing Don José's prison confession of his fateful obsession with her. Don José, a Basque soldier of noble origin, recounts how his encounter with Carmen in Seville drew him into smuggling, desertion, violence, and ultimately murder as their passionate but destructive relationship unfolds amid cultural clashes and personal jealousy. A fourth chapter, added in the 1846–1847 book editions, consists of an ethnographic essay on the physiognomy, customs, language, and supposed origins of the Spanish Romani people, reflecting Mérimée's scholarly interests.  
The novella draws on Mérimée's own travels in Spain beginning in 1830 and an anecdote reportedly shared with him by the Countess de Montijo, blending realism with elements of romantic exoticism. It explores themes of fatal passion, the allure and danger of cultural difference, the marginalization of ethnic groups such as Gypsies and Basques, and the power of language as a tool of seduction and manipulation. Mérimée's portrayal of Carmen as an independent, defiant figure embodies 19th-century French fascination with the exotic, the bizarre, and the "other," while highlighting tensions between individual freedom and societal constraints. The work has endured as a landmark in French Romantic literature and served as the principal inspiration for Georges Bizet's 1875 opera Carmen.

• In the uncharted northern wilderness, Reverend Thomas Elm and his band of zealots are building an army. 

• Young vagabond Porter Whitlock seeks to return to the Southern Isles, hoping to reclaim the treasure he’s left behind: a cache of gold bullion and a dark-skinned beauty named Ada. title: The Keys to Therapy
author: Samantha Newton, LCSW
description:
Grad school taught you theory. This podcast teaches you the rest.

Welcome to The Keys to Therapy: The podcast for therapists who want practical clinical skills, honest mentorship, and real-world guidance for building a sustainable and fulfilling career in mental health.

I’m Samantha Newton, Licensed Clinical Social Worker, therapist, educator, and mentor, and I created this space for therapists who feel overwhelmed, underprepared, stuck in imposter syndrome, or unsure how to bridge the gap between graduate school and real-life clinical work.

If you’ve ever thought: “Why didn’t anyone teach us this in grad school?”

You’re in the right place.

Each episode combines practical teaching, candid conversations, and therapist mentorship to help you build confidence in the therapy room and beyond. From session structure, documentation, and clinical skills to burnout prevention, boundaries, career growth, and the realities of working in the mental health field — we cover the things many therapists wish they had learned sooner.

Whether you’re a student, new therapist, associate, newly licensed clinician, or someone still trying to feel more confident and grounded in your work, you’re in the right place. Because confidence doesn’t come from a text book-it comes from practical knowledge, experience, and skills. 

Let’s build together. 

Welcome to The Keys to Therapy.

title: Life After Divorce with Blaise and Meg

description:
Life After Divorce is hosted by Blaise and Meg — a man and a woman who've both been through it, on opposite sides of the experience, and rebuilt from there. Blaise is the entrepreneur who lost his marriage and his business in the same month and clawed both back without borrowing a dollar. Meg is the single mother who's raised two kids alone with no co-parent and built a full-time career from nothing while she did it.

Twice a week, they sit down and talk — not as therapists, not as lawyers, but as two people who lived the worst version of this and came out further ahead than where they started. No performative positivity, no victim talk, no legal or clinical advice. Just what actually worked.

If you're divorced, separated, or standing in the middle of it right now wondering if anyone's done this and made it to the other side — this is that show.

Each episode gives you something to think about, something to notice, or something to carry into your day. We’ll explore identity, emotions, self-compassion, purpose, uncertainty, relationships, growth, and all the little things that shape how we experience our lives.


Listen over coffee, while getting ready, walking the dog, or before you reach for your phone.

description:
Welcome to Skiba News Nation — the independent media show and podcast with more than 150k subscribers and growing. Hosted by Jeremiah Skiba and Sidekick Jake Grant, Skiba News Nation dives headfirst into the stories, questions, controversies, conspiracies, current events, and forgotten history that deserve a closer look. From original investigations and hard-hitting commentary to special guests, comedy, hidden history, and conversations mainstream media often refuses to touch, SNN exists for people who are still willing to ask questions. Agencies absolutely talk down to you.
They’ll never admit it, but you feel it every time:
the condescending letters,
the dismissive emails,
the cold, superior tone that makes you wonder if you somehow did something wrong just by asking a question.
Most people think it’s personal.
It isn’t.
It’s structural — baked into templates, risk‑management language, and a culture that values “covering themselves” more than communicating with you.
In this episode, Jack breaks down some barriers to look inside the machine

Mums the Word Podcast 🎙️💜


Real mums. Real stories. Real conversations about maternal mental health.


Mums the Word is a safe and honest space where we talk about the parts of motherhood that aren’t always spoken about. Through lived experience, professional insight and conversations with mums and guests, we explore maternal mental health, anxiety, depression, birth trauma, recovery, relationships, identity and the realities of becoming a mum.


Hosted by Roisin, a Specialist Perinatal Mental Health Nurse, and Danielle, a mum with lived experience and co-founder of Mums the Word, the podcast was created to help break the stigma surrounding maternal mental health and remind women that they don’t have to navigate motherhood alone.


Our aim is simple: to empower, support and educate — one conversation at a time.


Because sometimes the most powerful words are: “Me too.” 💜

The Move for Life podcast also explores the role of the arts, creativity, and self-expression, as well as the importance of establishing a meaningful relationship with your physical body. These are conversations about how movement can help us express ourselves, understand our bodies, connect with others, and process some of the experiences that shape us.

Through these conversations, the hope is to inspire others to pursue a movement practice that resonates with them and to find a lively community that understands the importance of movement, creativity, and connection across generations.

title: A Daily Dose of Nostalgia
author: Joseph Belveduto
description: Remember when Saturday mornings meant cartoons, Friday nights meant a trip to the video store, and the internet screamed at you before you could even get online?  Welcome to A Daily Dose of Nostalgia, hosted by Joey Belveduto and brought to you by Nostalgic Ways.  Every day, we’re taking a few minutes to revisit the people, places, toys, movies, TV shows, video games, theme parks, snacks, trends, and random little memories that made growing up feel special.  Some days we’ll go back to something you haven’t thought about in 20 years. Other days, we’ll talk about why the things we grew up loving still mean so much to us today.  No matter where the conversation takes us, the goal is simple: slow things down for a few minutes, remember the good times, and maybe unlock a memory you forgot you even had.  Because sometimes you don't want to move backward — you just want to visit for a little while.  A Daily Dose of Nostalgia A few minutes of yesterday, every day.  Hosted by Joey Belveduto Presented by Nostalgic Ways — The love for yesterday & hope for tomorrow.

title: The Pedagouge
author: Jami Hunt-Williams
description:
The Pedagouge
Educational pain points that hurt us all.

Twenty-five years of research. The best of intentions. The most trusted names in the field. And still, somehow, millions of kids fall through the cracks — especially the ones who were never young enough to be anyone's priority.

The Pedagouge digs into the real, documented failures hiding inside American education — not vague frustration, but specific, sourced, follow-the-evidence investigation into why good systems keep producing bad outcomes. Hosted by Jami Hunt-Williams, a secondary English teacher with 19 years in the classroom who has spent that time doing both halves of the job most people do only one of — diagnosing exactly what's broken and building what actually works instead. Each episode traces one real problem back to its root, and asks the question most conversations about education are too polite to ask: not just "who let this happen," but "what would it actually take to fix it."

This isn't a show about blaming teachers. It's a show about naming what broke — and proving it can be rebuilt.

title: So...We're In College?

description: Starting high school can feel exciting, overwhelming, confusing—and sometimes all three at once. In this podcast, I’m taking you through my experience of my first year of high school, from making friends and finding your place to dealing with classes, activities, stress, and all the little things no one really prepares you for. Whether you’re nervous about starting or already in the middle of it, this is a place for honest stories, advice, and reminders that you don’t have to have everything figured out.

description: On Djoss Ensemble is a conversational podcast where we question reality without filters. description: Every marriage looks fine from the outside. Nobody Told Me Love Isn't Enough is the honest conversation nobody has before the wedding, or ten years into it. Marriage counsellor and author of Love Isn't Enough, Anita Daniels, shares real stories from her counselling room, the quiet ways couples stop reaching each other, and the exact words that change everything. The person you marry at twenty-five won't be the person you're loving at forty-five, and that's the whole point. This is the podcast that tells you the truth, gently, so your marriage can last.

title: Wherever We Are with Joel & Erin Comm

description:
Wherever We Are with Erin & Joel is about life as it happens—wherever we happen to be.
It started on our honeymoon, when we turned on a camera and started documenting the adventure. But we quickly realized this isn’t just a travel show.
Sometimes we’re exploring someplace we’ve never been. Sometimes we’re on a train, a ship or a plane. Sometimes we’re home talking about whatever life has thrown our way.

title: The Nightingale
author: Canal Infor
description:
When Vianne Mauriac receives a knock on the door in the dead of night, she faces a harrowing decision that will change her life forever. Set against the backdrop of World War II France, "The Nightingale" follows the intertwined journeys of two sisters, Vianne and Isabelle, as they navigate love, loss, and the fight for survival in a world torn apart by war. Vianne, a devoted mother, struggles to protect her family while dealing with the increasing dangers of Nazi occupation. Meanwhile, rebellious Isabelle embarks on a dangerous mission to resist the enemy, risking everything for the sake of freedom. 
This audiobook delves into the stark realities of war, the complexities of sisterhood, and the courage it takes to stand up against oppression. As the sisters' choices lead them down perilous paths, listeners will be drawn into their emotional struggles, witnessing the sacrifices made in the name of love and loyalty. Each chapter reveals a new layer of conflict, challenging the sisters' beliefs and testing their bonds. 
Join Vianne and Isabelle on their gripping journey filled with heart-wrenching moments and unexpected revelations. Discover how love can flourish even in the darkest of times, and find out if they can survive the ultimate test of faith and resilience. Whether you're a fan of historical fiction or looking to explore the depths of human courage, this powerful story will stay with you long after the final chapter.

title: The Failing Forward Podcast

College is full of pressure and uncertainty, and learning to take risks, own your setbacks, and lead boldly matters more than ever. "Fail early, fail often, but always fail forward." - John C. Maxwell

author: Wendi Williams
description:
The Well is a wellness-centered leadership podcast for leaders who are tired — not of the work, but from carrying it.


Dr. Wendi Williams has spent two decades in the rooms where the hardest decisions get made. She has led institutions through turnaround and crisis as a senior leader in higher education, carried fiduciary weight as a board chair across the nonprofit and for-profit sectors, and trained as a counseling psychologist who reads what sits beneath the leadership — the part no one names aloud. She is the current President of the American Psychological Association. Her work is grounded in Black Women's Liberatory Leadership (BWLL) Praxis, a framework that transcends identity to offer a universal blueprint for leaders committed to impact, equity, and sustainable transformation.


She knows what it costs to lead, because she has carried it.


Some weeks, you'll sit with a leader whose story of being pushed out, worn down, and finding their way back illuminates where you are now. Other weeks, Dr. Wendi turns to the research and to your questions directly, translating what the evidence means for your leadership, this week, in your life. Either way, every episode opens the same: a moment to center, research woven in rather than lectured, and one real thing you can use — whether you lead a company, a classroom, an office, or a home.


Seeking support is the beginning of the most important leadership work you will ever do.


Welcome to The Well. You are welcome here, exactly as you are.

title: Naturism, Nudism and Gymnosophy for the BARE-ly Curious
author: Naomi Gale
description:
Naturism for the BARE-ly Curious: Nudism & Gymnosophy. A nudist podcast show for anyone who's ever been curious about naturism. This isn't the nudist club version of naturism. It's the one where we get honest about naturism in the modern world. Each episode sits with what nudism and naturism actually feel like: the body, the freedom, the awkward moments, the surprising ordinariness of being naked once you begin. We explore BARE-ly through gymnosophy: the century-old philosophy of nakedness and wisdom that most people have never heard of. Consent, confidence, shame, curiosity, and the long, quietly radical history of people, especially women who have always explored the joy of choosing to bare all, some or nothing. You don't need to be a naturist to listen. You just need to be BARE-ly curious.

This isn’t about portraying veterans as broken, helpless, or statistics. It’s about real people, real scars, real struggles, and real victories. The goal is to have conversations that others may be afraid to have, challenge the stigma surrounding asking for help, connect veterans with resources, and remind people that prevention starts long before someone reaches a crisis. title: Good Morning, and Praise the Lord
author: James Newcomb
description: Good Morning, and Praise the Lord is a daily reflection on faith, meaning, community, and the presence of God in ordinary life.  Each episode follows a simple rhythm: Notice. Consider. Carry.  Notice begins with something worth paying attention to—a story, question, encounter, or moment that might otherwise pass unnoticed.  Consider looks beneath the surface, drawing from Scripture, Christian tradition, history, conversation, and lived experience to ask what that moment might reveal.  Carry brings the reflection back into daily life: one thought, conviction, or question worth taking with you into the day ahead.  Rooted in the ancient Christian tradition but spoken in the language of everyday life, Good Morning, and Praise the Lord is an invitation to begin the day with greater attention—to God, to one another, and to what may be happening just beneath the surface of the ordinary.

title: Loving You Shouldn't Be Hurting Me with Dr. Avery Neal

description:
Psychological Abuse and Its Effects on Physical and Mental Health
A groundbreaking investigation offering a definitive plan for recognizing and overcoming intimate partner violence and the breadth of its impact.
Loving You Shouldn't Be Hurting Me: Psychological Abuse and Its Effects on Physical and Mental Health is dedicated to women worldwide, of whom nearly half in the United States (or approximately 57.6 million women) have experienced psychological aggression. This invisible cruelty is the underpinning for all other forms of mistreatment, making it the most difficult obstacle from which to recover. Moreover, clinical research indicates that subtle psychological abuse inflicts the most devastating damage. This book addresses the global crisis head-on.
Anyone trapped in an unhealthy, toxic, or controlling relationship will find a clear path forward in this book, whether the relationship is ongoing, long over, or rooted in childhood trauma. Those who have experienced physical or mental health symptoms as a result of this chronic manipulation will find immediate validation and a comprehensive roadmap on how to truly heal the mind, body, and spirit.
While statistics show women are more likely to experience the adverse physical and emotional effects of abuse—and are historically more likely to seek out self-help resources—this work is inclusive of all kinds of trauma. Drawing on a career that has been devoted to helping all survivors heal, Dr. Neal also explicitly addresses how men and children are impacted by the sweeping devastation of psychological abuse.

title: מאחורי המראה עם מיכל באום ואורית כהן
author: Michal Baum
description:
הפודקאסט של מיכל באום ואורית כהן
מה באמת מסתתר מאחורי המראה?
מאחורי הבגד שבחרנו, מאחורי הסטייל, מאחורי המחמאה שקיבלנו, ומאחורי הדרך שבה אנחנו מציגות את עצמנו לעולם – יש סיפור.
”מאחורי המראה” הוא פודקאסט על נשים, ביטחון עצמי, דימוי עצמי, סטייל, יופי וכל מה שביניהם. אבל יותר מכל, הוא פודקאסט על החיים עצמם.
בכל פרק נדבר על הנושאים שמעסיקים נשים בכל גיל ובכל שלב בחיים: איך אנחנו רואות את עצמנו, איך אנחנו רוצות להרגיש, מה משפיע על הביטחון שלנו, איך אופנה וסטייל יכולים להיות כלי לביטוי אישי, ומה קורה כשאנחנו מפסיקות להתמקד רק במה שרואים מבחוץ ומתחילות להתחבר למה שקורה בפנים.
אנחנו מביאות לשולחן שיחות פתוחות, כנות ומעשיות, המבוססות על שנים של עבודה עם נשים, לצד תובנות, סיפורים, חוויות וכלים שיכולים לעזור לכל אישה להרגיש טוב יותר עם עצמה.
אני מיכל באום, סטייליסטית ובעלת בית אופנה לנשים, המאמינה שלבוש הוא הרבה יותר מבגד – הוא דרך לבטא נוכחות, ביטחון ותחושת ערך.
ואני אורית כהן, סטייליסטית ומלווה נשים בתהליכי סטיילינג אישי, דימוי עצמי ובניית סגנון אישי.
ביחד יצרנו את ”מאחורי המראה” – מקום שבו אופנה היא רק נקודת ההתחלה, והשיחה האמיתית היא על האישה שמאחוריה.
אם גם את מאמינה שיופי מתחיל בתחושה, שביטחון עצמי הוא תהליך, ושיש הרבה יותר מאחורי מה שרואים במראה – הפודקאסט הזה בשבילך.
אנחנו מזמינות אותך להצטרף אלינו למסע של השראה, גילוי עצמי, סטייל, צמיחה ושיחות מהלב.

description:
The Pendeja Podcast was created purposely to get your ATTENTION.
Depending on where you are from in Latin America, this word can mean the plant (El Pendejo - Spinossum alyssum), a funny reference among friends, or something very offensive.
The Pendeja Podcast stands on 5 pillars:
*COMMUNITY
*ENTERTAINMENT
*EMPOWERMENT
*ENTREPRENUERSHIP
*COMMUNITY REINVESTMENT
At its core, the Pendeja Podcast is a platform celebrating and featuring members of our community. We share success stories and invite entrepreneurs who merit a shining light of awareness and recognition.
One thing all people can relate to are mistakes and important lessons we learn along the way to help us reach our goals.
These elements of trial and error or “mistakes” ... we refer to as “Pendejadas”.
Sharing our “Pendejadas” is a fun way to laugh at ourselves and our life lessons and welcome others to laugh WITH us. The Pendeja Podcast allows you to make fun of yourself and not someone else.
Over time we look forward to making the word “Pendeja” only funny and never offensive, globally.

Welcome to the Anxious for Nothing Podcast. 

"Do not be anxious about anything, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known to God. [7] And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus. -Philippians 4:6–7

We live in anxious times where we are bombarded by the problems of this life, the news and social media. It can make one feel anxious and depressed when we read the news, face challenges in this life. Our gaze is too often focused on what is before us. We lose sight of Who is above us. description: Veterans Benefits & Beyond is a podcast dedicated to helping veterans and their families understand and navigate the complex world of veterans' benefits. Each episode features expert guests who break down the legalities and processes involved in securing the benefits veterans have earned through their service. The show aims to empower listeners with practical advice and insights, ensuring they have the knowledge needed to advocate for themselves effectively. Whether you're a veteran, a family member, or someone interested in veterans' rights, this podcast offers valuable information in a clear and accessible format.

title: Wow in the World
author: cdes
description: Wow in the World is the #1 science podcast for kids and families, sharing the most amazing stories in science, technology, and new discoveries happening in the world around us. Each week, join hosts Mindy Thomas and Guy Raz as they take curious kids and their grown-ups on a cartoon for the ear journey filled with laughter, adventure, and wow-worthy stories. From the tiniest microbes to the farthest reaches of space, every episode of Wow in the World inspires wonder, fuels imagination, and makes science fun for the whole family. Weekly episodes of Wow in the World come out every Monday for free!
